description: This file contains utility functions, data access functions, and business logic for handling MCP (Multi-Cloud Provider / Managed Cloud Platform) server records within a database context, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and credential encryption. It also manages permissions and access controls related to MCP servers.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _prepare_mcp_server_data( data: Union[NewMCPServerRequest, UpdateMCPServerRequest], )
methods.description: Prepares MCP server request data by serializing complex fields such as mcp_info, env, and credentials for database storage.

methods.name: MCPCredentials encrypt_credentials( credentials: MCPCredentials, encryption_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Encrypts sensitive credential fields ('auth_value', 'client_id', 'client_secret') within MCPCredentials using a provided encryption key.

methods.name: List[LiteLLM_MCPServerTable] get_all_mcp_servers( prisma_client: PrismaClient, )
methods.description: Fetches all MCP server records from the database.

methods.name: Optional[LiteLLM_MCPServerTable] get_mcp_server( prisma_client: PrismaClient, server_id: str )
methods.description: Retrieves a single MCP server record by its server_id.

methods.name: List[LiteLLM_MCPServerTable] get_mcp_servers( prisma_client: PrismaClient, server_ids: Iterable[str] )
methods.description: Retrieves multiple MCP server records by a list of server_ids.

methods.name: List[str] get_mcp_servers_by_verificationtoken( prisma_client: PrismaClient, token: str )
methods.description: Fetches MCP server references associated with a given verification token

methods.name: List[str] get_mcp_servers_by_team( prisma_client: PrismaClient, team_id: str )
methods.description: Fetches MCP server references associated with a specific team.

methods.name: List[LiteLLM_MCPServerTable] get_all_mcp_servers_for_user( prisma_client: PrismaClient, user: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Retrieves all MCP servers accessible to a given user based on verification tokens and team membership.

methods.name: List[LiteLLM_ObjectPermissionTable] get_objectpermissions_for_mcp_server( prisma_client: PrismaClient, mcp_server_id: str )
methods.description: Retrieves object permission records associated with a specific MCP server.

methods.name: List get_virtualkeys_for_mcp_server( prisma_client: PrismaClient, server_id: str )
methods.description: Fetches virtual keys associated with a specific MCP server.

methods.name: delete_mcp_server_from_team(prisma_client: PrismaClient, server_id: str)
methods.description: Removes an MCP server reference from a team (function stub; implementation not provided).

methods.name: delete_mcp_server_from_virtualkey()
methods.description: Removes an MCP server reference from a virtual key (function stub; implementation not provided).

methods.name: Optional[LiteLLM_MCPServerTable] delete_mcp_server( prisma_client: PrismaClient, server_id: str )
methods.description: Deletes an MCP server record from the database by server_id.

methods.name: LiteLLM_MCPServerTable create_mcp_server( prisma_client: PrismaClient, data: NewMCPServerRequest, touched_by: str )
methods.description: Creates and stores a new MCP server record in the database, generating a new server_id if necessary.

methods.name: LiteLLM_MCPServerTable update_mcp_server( prisma_client: PrismaClient, data: UpdateMCPServerRequest, touched_by: str )
methods.description: Updates an existing MCP server record with new data.

methods.name: rotate_mcp_server_credentials_master_key( prisma_client: PrismaClient, touched_by: str, new_master_key: str )
methods.description: Rotates/updates the master encryption key for all MCP server credentials, re-encrypting each credential with the new key.
